thread:
jamie: quick heads-up — I'm dropping a PR that adds annotated examples to the v2 migration guide. It's mostly snippets for embed/model swap and a few deprecation notes. need an owner for final approval :eyes:

elaine: can you link the PR? want to check the embed dim section

jamie: link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 it's the 'annotated-examples' branch

sasha: skimmed — LGTM for structure but one inline snippet uses old `models.invoke` shape. that'll break. i'll add suggested patch

matt: which snippet? ping the file path

sasha: docs/guides/migration/v1-to-v2.md lines ~220-240, the `model.invoke({input})` example. should be `client.responses.create({model: 'mira', input: ...})`

jamie: good catch. i'll push a fix. also thinking about adding a tiny code fence showing the fallback policy, e.g.,

```
# suggested fallback policy
routing:
  primary: "redwood-mira"
  fallback: "redwood-mira-tiny"
```

pranav: also flagging the note about vector dims — when we mention `embedding_dim` change include a short migration snippet to resize matrices, otherwise ppl copy pasta and crash :grimacing:

jeremy: suggestion: add a 1-line smoke test for each example. CI can run them quickly. don't want broken snippets in prod docs

docs-bot: CI status — tests/pass: snippets-smoke-tests passed on branch annotated-examples (run 2026-02-18T10:12:03Z) :white_check_mark:

jamie: awesome. who can own the final PR review? I'd like docs + eng sign-off. @elaine? @matt?

elaine: I can review examples and wording before EOD

matt: I'll do an eng pass tomorrow morning, focus on API correctness and any migration gotchas

sasha: i'll open a tiny follow-up PR to replace remaining `invoke` instances if any are missed

jamie: thanks all. plan: jamie pushes fix -> docs-bot CI -> elaine review -> matt engineer sign-off -> merge. adding issue tracker link for follow-ups: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/999

matt: small nit — update the migration checklist to mention "pin model versions in Dedicated customers" under rollouts

jamie: added that to checklist in PR

elaine: :thumbsup: merging after reviews

jamie: merging today unless objections

sasha: none here. :rocket:
